newsitem.title: USA: Ultrafem sees Q3 revenues of $900,000.
newsitem.headline: Ultrafem sees Q3 revenues of $900,000.

text.p: Ultrafem Inc said Thursday revenues for the third quarter ended March 31 are expected to meet analysts' estimates of $900,000, a 94 percent increase over second quarter revenues of $462,290.

"As we had forecast earlier, INSTEAD experienced a significant ramp-up in March with estimated revenues of $500,000 for the month," said John W. Andersen, president and chief executive officer, said. "The monthly rate of revenues for Wave I alone translates to a national, annual revenue level of $50 million after being in the market for only six months, assuming the same level of consumer takeaway."
